textbooks.reason: The catalogue and C17 exact extracted reading candidates are indexed separately. Twelve C17 boundaries are reported checked, but extraction spelling/spacing and target senses are not fully reviewed; candidates never add delivered/scheduled coverage. C19 reserved sources are excluded.

evidenceIndex.format: One JSON record per headword; exact UTF-16 text offsets and source hashes, at most two occurrence proofs and two glossary proofs per cohort.

limits: The 8000 dictionary examples and all vocabulary-card example corpora are excluded as input reading/listening texts.
Reserved gate/final/full-test/independent-bank sources are excluded from training evidence and vocabulary pre-teaching.
Exact word tokens and source-listed inflections prove orthographic presence only. Homographs, names and differing senses still require contextual checking.

Meaning-label identity is only explicit authored Chinese-label agreement with an exact source quote, not independent semantic validation or full sense coverage. Differing labels are not silently equated.
Pending year-expansion files are candidate-only and never count as delivered scheduled coverage.
Original 52 lessons are a supplemental corpus; lexical presence does not prove the learner has read or heard them. No exposure, mastery, curriculum requirement or learner data is altered.
